A '''Flash-sterilizer''' was a type of medical tool used to clear a wound of any bacteria and germs.<ref name="MedStar II">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] injured her foot while practicing with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kornell Divini]] treated her injury and used a flash-sterilizer to clean the wound.<ref name="MedStar II" />
